title: Honeymoon Getaway to Bali | Swing, Safari & Sea Shores
highlights: Embark on a romantic journey through Bali’s breathtaking landscapes, where sacred temples, thrilling adventures, and iconic beaches await.
Stay at carefully chosen hotels, offering beachfront views, spacious rooms, and trusted brands to ensure a comfortable and memorable Bali stay.
Capture unforgettable memories with a complimentary 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul, where stunning backdrops make every moment picture-perfect.
Rejuvenate at Bali’s handpicked spas, where authentic therapies, soothing ambience, and exclusive deals of up to 50% off create the perfect wellness escape.
Set off on a vintage Volkswagen car tour through Central Bali, cruising past scenic landscapes and lush green steps that showcase the island’s timeless beauty.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Bali on this unforgettable journey that blends adventure, culture, and relaxation. Begin in Ubud, exploring sacred sites like Goa Gajah, vibrant bird parks, and thrilling waterparks. Discover Tegenungan Waterfall, swing over rice paddies, purify yourself at Tirta Empul, and admire the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terrace. In Bedugul, capture the beauty of Handara Gate, marvel at Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, and trek to the hidden Leke Leke Waterfall. Cruise to Nusa Penida’s west coast to see the T-Rex cliffs of Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, Paluang Cliff, and relax at Crystal Bay. Aslo, enjoy thrilling watersports at Tanjung Benoa, sunsets at Uluwatu Temple with the Kecak Fire Show, and shopping at Kuta Market.

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to the hotel in Ubud and check in to your beautifully decorated room. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or step out to explore Bali’s charm. You can visit Goa Gajah, the ancient ‘Elephant Cave’ adorned with sacred carvings, or stroll through Bali Bird Park, home to vibrant exotic species. For thrill-seekers, cool off at Waterbom Bali, Asia’s top-rated waterpark, offering fun-filled experiences for all.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen
days.desc: Begin your day with a complimentary floating breakfast, a unique way to soak in Bali’s charm. Then, embark on a Central Bali Volkswagen vintage car tour, where classic style meets amazing scenery. Feel the thrill of the iconic Bali Swing, soaring above lush valleys, before visiting the Tegenungan Waterfall. Also, visit Tirta Empul Temple, renowned for its sacred spring pools, and capture moments with a photoshoot at Sari Timbul. Conclude your day at Tegallalang Rice Terrace, a UNESCO treasure.

items.title: Transfer in Vintage Volkswagen
items.desc: 1 X Vintage Volkswagen will be Provided

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, discover the natural beauty and cultural charm of Bedugul. Begin at the iconic Handara Gate, renowned for its traditional Balinese architecture and breathtaking mountain backdrop—perfect for a memorable photo stop. Continue to Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a sacred site that appears to float on the waters of Lake Beratan. Conclude with a refreshing trek to Leke Leke Waterfalls, a hidden paradise where crystal-clear waters cascade through lush tropical greenery. Later, get driven to the hotel.

items.title: Full Day Bedugul Tour in Bali - Handara Gate + Ulun Danu Beraton + Leke Leke Waterfalls

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Visit to Melasti Beach Tour | Watersports at Tenjung Benoa | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire & Dance Show | Kuta Market Visit
days.desc: After check-out, enjoy a scenic journey to Kuta with a stop at Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s adventure hotspot, where you can dive into thrilling watersports like jet skiing and banana boat rides. Also, relish a delightful lunch before visiting the Melasti Beach, renowned for its limestone cliffs. Continue to the iconic Uluwatu Temple, dramatically perched above the ocean, and witness the enchanting Kecak Fire Dance at sunset. Later, explore the bustling Kuta Market before checking in at your hotel.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach + Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire Dance Show + Melasti Beach + Kuta Market with Lunch

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff
days.desc: Begin your day with a drive to Sanur Port and board a speedboat to Nusa Penida for an unforgettable west coast tour. Your first stop is Kelingking Beach, world-famous for its T-Rex–shaped cliff and sweeping views of the turquoise ocean. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural rock pool, before marveling at the dramatic sea arch of Broken Bay. Afterwards, visit Paluang Cliff, a hidden vantage point offering panoramic views, & marvel at the crystal-clear waters of Crystal Bay.

items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and board your transfer to the airport for your onward journey. As you board your flight, bid farewell to the enchanting island of Bali, taking back unforgettable memories of its beaches, temples, waterfalls, and vibrant culture. This marks the end of your Bali tour.
